how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_007.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensuramoreskills|tensuramoreskills: At 100% Bloom, press to seal everyone nearby inside the Field of a Thousand Flowers, your own flower realm, for 120 seconds. Everyone returns where they stood when it ends. Shift + Press closes it early and refunds 50% of the cost.
Open Tensura’s spell selector. Selected library spells join the move cycle.
Open a collapsing sphere. Shift + press collapses it early.
Strike up to five enemies and chain lightning. Shift + press fires Thunderbolt.
Raise a stone shield for two minutes. Shift + press detonates it.
Create one copy with a separate magicule reserve. Shift + press dismisses it and refunds unused magicules.
Fake a magicule surge, interrupt enemies and weaken their magic resistance.
Hold while aiming at an enemy. Releases a Black Hole, lightning, and a sealing golem. Damage increases when concealment hid your strength. Locks concealment for 30 seconds.
Press to switch to Mirror. Use the skill toggle for Mana Suppression. While slotted: +250% spell learning and mastery, 75% lower spell cost.
Press to switch to Archivist. Use the skill toggle for Perfect Concealment: 5% perceived MP, blocked appraisal, and 10% lower MP regeneration.
Cast Black Hole, Lightning, and Golem within 10 seconds. Your mirror casts count. Automatically grants +250% spell damage and a three-element aura for 30 seconds. Press to check its status.

God's Favourite: Holy and Light damage x1.5 (x2 mastered), Blessed and Heavenly Eye. Chosen One: Inspiration I while holding Excalibur. Summon Excalibur for 500,000 MP, hold Holy Order or Light Ray, or cycle Holy Aura through Holy, Light and off. Mastery grows through holy/light damage, successful casts and maintained abilities.

Master of All: +1% physical and Battlewill damage per mastered Battlewill. Weapon Master: +3 Battlewill learning and x1.5 Battlewill damage. Sword: Strength II/III and Haste I/II; shield: Resistance I offhand, II mainhand; pickaxe: Haste II/III. Toggle King's Endurance for +30% melee dodge, projectile dodging and Regeneration I. Sword Master grants Aura Sword I (II with Excalibur). Mastery grows through attacks, successful casts and King's Endurance.
